description: Hand review of every finding on the benchmark jars, gate tier in benchmark/manifest.json and extended tier in benchmark/extended/manifest.json. A label covers one piece of code wherever it appears, identified by the class file's SHA-1, the rule, and the method, together with the claim the finding makes, its severity, origin, and safeguard. Warning and Critical findings are labeled true-positive or false-positive. Notices are labeled accurate or inaccurate, judged on whether their origin and safeguard describe the code correctly. The example names one place the code was found.

Netty's ObjectDecoder reads the ByteBuf it is handed through CompactObjectInputStream, whose resolveClass passes every name to a ClassResolver without rejecting any, so network data can name any class. Netty deprecated the class as insecure for this reason. No class in Essential references ObjectDecoder, so this bundled copy is unsafe code that never runs.
